1.title: Part 1: The Apple & The Fleet

lines.raw: About three thousand two hundred years ago, a walled city on a windy hill in what is now Turkey burned to the ground. What came after is a mix of poetry, memory, and shovel work. The Greeks said it fell over one woman. Their poets blamed a grudge between goddesses. Archaeologists point to something far less romantic. So which one is it? To find out, we start where the Greeks started: with a wedding, and a guest list that went very wrong.
